name: io.github.sapientsai/beszel-mcp-server
description: Read a Beszel hub: monitored systems, metrics over time, containers, systemd services, disks and alerts.

environmentVariables.name: BESZEL_URL
environmentVariables.description: Your Beszel hub's base URL, e.g. https://beszel.example.com

environmentVariables.name: BESZEL_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Email of the Beszel user to sign in as, ideally one with the readonly role. Not needed with BESZEL_TOKEN.

environmentVariables.name: BESZEL_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: That user's password. Not needed with BESZEL_TOKEN.

environmentVariables.name: BESZEL_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: A PocketBase auth token, instead of an email and password (for hubs that allow OAuth sign-in only).
